profile.summary: A company in Gilroy, California that provides special education services for students with visual impairments. Its staff include credentialed Teachers of the Visually Impaired and Orientation and Mobility specialists, and it also offers Intervener services for students with deafblindness. It is an approved Nonpublic Agency under the California Department of Education.
